<!-- GENERATED by kizunashelf-docs (crates/kizunashelf/src/bin/docs.rs); do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `pnpm docs:generate`. -->

Generated directly from the app's provider catalog — the same one that powers matching, Quick Capture, and the Settings credential editors — so it always matches the version you're running. A provider is wired into a type through an `externalRef` field (and optionally `externalFields` / external body sections); see [External Metadata](@/reference/external.md#external-metadata).

On self-hosted web, credentials come from the listed `KIZUNASHELF_*` environment variables; on desktop and iOS they are entered under **Settings → Provider Credentials** and stored in the OS keychain.

| Provider | `externalRef` id | Search | Episode/track sync | Credentials |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Bangumi](#bangumi) | `bangumi` | search + resolve | yes | none |
| [IGDB](#igdb) | `igdb` | search + resolve | — | IGDB Client ID, IGDB Client Secret |
| [TheTVDB](#thetvdb) | `thetvdb` | search + resolve | yes | TheTVDB API Key, TheTVDB PIN (optional) (optional) |
| [Google Books](#googlebooks) | `googlebooks` | search + resolve | — | Google Books API Key |
| [Open Library](#openlibrary) | `openlibrary` | search + resolve | — | none |
| [Apple Podcasts](#applepodcast) | `applepodcast` | search + resolve | yes | none |
| [Apple Music](#applemusic) | `applemusic` | search + resolve | yes | none |
| [Steam](#steam) | `steam` | resolve URL/id only | — | none |
| [MusicBrainz](#musicbrainz) | `musicbrainz` | search + resolve | yes | none |
| [BoardGameGeek](#bgg) | `bgg` | search + resolve | — | BGG XML API Token |
| [TMDB](#tmdb) | `tmdb` | search + resolve | yes | TMDB API Key |
| [Discogs](#discogs) | `discogs` | search + resolve | yes | Discogs Personal Access Token (optional), Discogs Consumer Key (optional), Discogs Consumer Secret (optional) |
| [MyAnimeList](#myanimelist) | `myanimelist` | search + resolve | yes | MyAnimeList Client ID |
| [MangaUpdates](#mangaupdates) | `mangaupdates` | search + resolve | — | none |
| [Comic Vine](#comicvine) | `comicvine` | search + resolve | yes | Comic Vine API Key |
| [Hardcover](#hardcover) | `hardcover` | search + resolve | — | Hardcover API Token |
| [NeoDB](#neodb) | `neodb` | search + resolve | — | none |
| [AniList](#anilist) | `anilist` | search + resolve | yes | none |
